Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFTimestampService

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFTimestampService
public final class CPDFTimestampService extends Object
RFC 3161 timestamp tokens and independent PDF document timestamps.

Initialize the SDK first and call on a worker thread. Adding a document timestamp creates a new ETSI.RFC3161 signature field using the TSA's identity; it requires no user's signing private key. It is distinct from the embedded timestamp provided by the existing PKCS#12/PAdES-T signing APIs.

    • addDocumentTimestamp

      public static CPDFSignatureCreateResult addDocumentTimestamp(String inputPath, String outputPath, CPDFTimestampOptions tsa, CPDFSignatureOptions signature)
      Appends a document timestamp to a saved PDF, including a two-phase signing result.

      The output must be new and distinct from the input. The Core document timestamp signer currently computes SHA-256; selecting another digest is explicitly rejected. Post-sign verification defaults to enabled and is reported separately from creation success. Configure trusted TSA roots through the signature options' validation settings. No LTV evidence is collected.

      Parameters:
      inputPath - readable saved PDF; encrypted inputs are not supported
      outputPath - new output file in an existing directory
      tsa - required TSA endpoint, transport and request settings
      signature - field, capacity and verification settings; null uses defaults
      Returns:
      publication result and the new timestamp field's full verification report
